content.short: Venly is a Web3 development platform offering wallet services, NFT tools, and marketplace solutions.
content.description: Venly provides a Web3 development platform that helps businesses integrate blockchain technology and onboard users. It delivers a complete tech stack to bring brands, apps, games, and platforms into Web3. Venly offers blockchain-, platform-, and vertical-agnostic developer tools for Web3. Its APIs and SDKs are simple to use and quick to implement, designed to onboard, engage, and grow your customer base within Web3 projects. Built for developers and product teams seeking fast integration and sustained user growth.
